title: Why Reusing One Password Is A Digital Life Risk
hook: 3,322 US breaches last year wiped out your password's safety.
closing: Reuse a password, and you're gambling your digital life.
question: Do you reuse one password everywhere? Be honest.

segments.say: US data breaches hit a record 3,322 last year.
People without a password manager are far more likely to get breached again, about 32 percent of them.
Financial services got hit 739 times last year, more than any other industry.
